ordering: Even replicate: off baseline,off candidate,on candidate,on baseline. Odd replicate: on baseline,on candidate,off candidate,off baseline. Each entry is a separate clean Player process under the same shared GPU lock.
primaryMetric: finishMs: scheduled release of job 0 to host verification of the GPU result of job 383
statistics: For each capture mode, one baseline/candidate finish ratio per independent replicate, geometric mean and Student-t 95% interval on five log ratios (df4). CV uses five finish values per arm; baseline drift is absolute last/first finish change. p95 gate uses geometric mean of five paired per-process p95 result-latency ratios. Individual jobs are not independent replicates.
publicationGate: Correctness and equal-work for every job in all 20 processes, all primary gates pass in both capture modes, and capture-on/off geometric mean finish ratio differs from one by at most 10% for each arm. No stable display-frame claim.
videoSelection: Replicate 0 capture-on pair fixed before confirmation; do not substitute a faster-looking pair. No retiming. Align first visible white start marker, retain alignment uncertainty and same-run logs. Capture is 55 seconds including about 2 seconds pre-start; final side-by-side view is first 50 seconds after marker if both full completions fit. Longer raw recordings remain available.
completionScope: Nonblocking async GPU readback of 160 bytes per job followed by validation of ten digest/metadata records. Completion timestamps are host-observed result availability, not exact GPU completion ticks.
workloadScope: Existing hotspot-dynamic input trajectory, full index rebuild and nine queries. Live point-cloud drawing and same HUD remain enabled in both capture modes. Init/upload of initial input, warmup and final serialization excluded from finishMs; changed-job uploads, job recording, queue time, GPU execution, readback and verification included. No native timing plugin events.
stopRule: One attempt per frozen cell; preserve all failures. Correctness or binary/source identity failure stops remaining cells. No workload/rate/algorithm changes or repeated cells to obtain a passing result. Video hold extension from engineering preflight 35s to 55s changes only post-work recording coverage, not arrival schedule or measured work.
cachePolicy: Natural user OS/driver cache state, no global cache resets. Same eight warmup jobs per process. No driver, power or permission changes. Visible identical owned windows for recorder-on and recorder-off.
